evidence.summary: The US Entity List names the Second Academy of China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC), with thirteen subordinate institutions. CASIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and describes itself as the main force in building China’s defence weapons and equipment, making China’s full range of missile weapon systems. The US Commerce Department listed it in August 2018, finding an unacceptable risk that it would use US-origin items in, or divert them to, military end-use activities in China.
It belongs to CASIC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
